lists.name: RYM Top — Rock — British Rhythm & Blues

podcast.body: Confusingly titled, this album was mostly produced by Tom Wilson. Notably, two of its tracks did not feature the actual band musicians, as Wilson farmed them out to a protégé, using session musicians with only Eric Burden from the group participating. "The album After Animalisms, confusingly titled Animalism, was also mostly produced by Wilson, and didn't even feature the musicians in the band on two of the tracks, which Wilson farmed out to a protégé of his, for example, to produce."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 115: "House of the Rising Sun" by the Animals
